sections.title: Test Coverage Analysis
sections.content:
**Zero test files exist.** No test framework is installed (no jest, vitest, or similar in `package.json`). Everything is untested.

Missing scenarios
9. Integration Test Gaps
Summary of Gaps
sections.content:
| Area | Tests Missing | Priority |
|------|--------------|----------|
| `utils.ts` | `cn`, `formatCurrency`, `formatDate` | Low |
| `auth.ts` | All auth logic, jwt/session callbacks | **High** |
| `employees` GET/POST | Auth, validation, code generation | **High** |
| `employees/[id]` | Soft-delete, cross-tenant | **High** |
| `attendance` | Upsert behavior, tenant check | Medium |
| `departments` | Role-based access (403), duplicate (409) | **High** |
| `leaves` | Role gate, invalid status, tenant checks | **High** |
| `payroll/process` | Tax calc, ACTIVE filter, 409 on re-run | **High** |
| Integration | Tenant isolation, full workflows | **Critical** |

**Recommendation:** Install `jest` + `ts-jest` (or `vitest`) and `@testing-library/react` for component tests, then start with the auth and role-based access gaps as they guard all business logic.
